messages.subject: fixation index and TajimaD
parts:
Hello,

I have four vcf files with extracted SNPs from four different chromosomes of the same organism. I want to calculate the fixation index and TajimaD between these chromosomes (chr1 vs chr2, chr1 vs chr3, chr1 vs chr4, etc.). Is there a function to calculate fixation index and TajimaD?

Thank you.

Maria.
